lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: north along Harbour Road past Crown Road; south-west down Sunset Way past Comet Row. Both termini and the depot are off-sheet and not yet planned

notes: Kept as they are (not listed): S1 Skyport Line, a straight double trunk with a skyport loop, and T1, the Boulevard trunk with its balloon loop round the circus island. Tide's 'T1 through the circus' is how T1 already works: it turns on the island loop (T-L1). Running on up Crown Avenue to Crown Road is still an open plan question for Sky. I have not changed it.

Sky Loop rejected under S-C1. At the ring corners, a radius-70 fillet (the S-R1 minimum) cuts about 29 m inside the corner point. The kerb corner of a 24 m road is only about 17 m in, so the beam would pass over corner plots such as Crown Terraces. The loop also conflicts with the plan concept: one straight trunk, with the Sphere loop and quay loop retired. That retirement is still Sky's open question.

T2 runs in the east carriageway of Harbour Road (track centre x 308, rails inside the 312 kerb, quay beyond). It turns west on Comet Row with a radius-50 fillet whose inner rail clears the kerb corner by about 5 m. It crosses to the north carriageway between x −140 and −240 (radius-200 fillets), then turns south onto Sunset Way's west carriageway with the same 5 m clearance and leaves the sheet at y −780.

Why T2 doesn't join T1 on the Boulevard: turning from Comet Row into the 28 m Boulevard at radius 50 clears the kerb by under 1 m. The Harbour Road to Market Street turn fails T-C1 outright. So T2 leaves the sheet at both ends on primary roads. That meets N-D1 without a terminal loop, and no balloon fits in street space here.

N-C1, for Vantage: T2 runs 32 m from the S1 Harbour station (340,0). T2 crosses T1 at the Boulevard (0,−728) on a flat diamond crossing, about 40 m from T1's Comet Row stop (0,−690). Both pairs are inside the 150 m interchange limit.

Coverage: Harbour Road stops serve Harbour East, Docks East and Docks South, which are about 260 m from T1 stops (reach 250). Comet Row stops serve Lantern West and Docks South. Vantage places the stops; spacing is 300–500 m.

I have not run the plan checker; I have no shell here. Fillet clearances are hand-calculated against road widths. Splice should confirm that T-C1 counts the junction area between kerb corners as street space, and that it tests the rails, not just the centreline.
No speeds, timetables or fares are set here. Those are Pulse's. No off-sheet destinations are named, because no source names them.
